text: なげれば　かならず　ポケモンを　つかまえられる！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえられる！

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to ば means 'if'. なげれば = 'if you throw it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on the verb here says that you are able to do it. つかまえられる = 'can catch'.
